column2: function start — MeasureSpriteFrameBounds; scans all sprite frame rectangles and returns their count dimensions and minimum and maximum local bounds.
function start — UpdateVelocityWrappedSpriteCloneStrip; converts actor displacement into the clone strip's accumulated scrolling offset while cancelling normal actor movement.
function start — DrawSpriteCloneAtHorizontalOffset; projects each sprite frame at a supplied offset while preserving UV orientation flipping and ordering depth.
function start — DrawVelocityWrappedSpriteCloneStrip; repeats complete sprite clones one measured width apart in both directions until they cover the screen.
function start — CreateVelocityWrappedSpriteCloneStrip; registers the actor-owned effect marks its actor flag and clears the accumulated wrap offset.
